content.comment_body: Hello, I used a 250 GB card in standard format. Since then, my [product_name] has stopped working properly—I can't communicate over ethernet. I’ve tried to restore factory settings but can’t find the option, even after attempting both admin and operator modes. Thank you and best regards, [user_name].
Sometimes I feel like I'm in the wrong situation. Why haven’t you checked the manual? The manual provides a lot of information, including details about the menu structure of [product_name].
I've attached the menu structure of [product_name]. The 'Factory Reset' option is available in the setup menu, but only visible if you're in Admin mode.
I’ve tried multiple times and attached a photo for reference. Thanks and regards, [user_name].

You need to set your [product_name] to STOP mode. Then, select the 'Setup' option and press OK. After that, navigate to 'Factory Reset' and confirm with OK. You should find this option between 'Menu language' and 'Switch to OP'.

Good morning. I've repeated these steps several times, and as you can see in the photo, the factory reset does not appear. This has been the case since I inserted the card—the screen turned red and showed an error I can't recall. Thanks and best regards, [user_name].

Good morning. I've noticed there's a firmware available in the forum to restore [product_name] to factory state. Mine is at [version_no]—is it possible to use the firmware, and where could I download it? Thanks and regards, [user_name].

A [product_name] with firmware version [version_no] is a first-generation model, specifically [version_no]. This device cannot be upgraded, and there's no factory reset. The 'Reset Tool' is only usable for the current [version_no] devices.
So there's no factory reset option in my case. I guess it can’t be fixed—thanks and regards, [user_name].

Wait a moment—let’s not rush to dispose of it. Please provide a detailed description of your problem. You mentioned ethernet connectivity issues. If you search for available [product_name] devices in [product_name] software, is your device being detected? Does your [product_name] have a display, and what IP address and subnet mask are shown?
I couldn’t locate the factory reset. I suppose it’s not possible—thanks and regards, [user_name].

Good evening. I checked and reconfigured my computer’s network and internet settings. Now, the computer can communicate with the [product_name]. I didn't check this before because my other [product_name] didn’t have any communication issues. Thanks and regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered issues with a [product_name] device after inserting a 250 GB microSD card, resulting in a loss of ethernet connectivity and inability to perform a factory reset. The user could not find the factory reset option, later learning that this hardware version does not support either factory reset or firmware upgrade. Troubleshooting revealed frustration stemming from unclear product limitations and a lack of solutions for restoring the device’s functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hoped to restore the [product_name] device to its factory settings using menu options or firmware updates and expected ethernet connectivity to be recoverable across all versions. They assumed reset and recovery features would be available on all models regardless of hardware generation.
